name: starmemory
description: Hybrid recall for Claude Code, Codex and Cowork conversations: Tantivy BM25 + usearch HNSW over LMDB, fused by reciprocal rank. All three share one memory.

interface.shortDescription: One shared memory for Claude Code, Codex and Cowork conversations
interface.longDescription: StarMemory indexes Claude Code and Codex transcripts, and the records Cowork sessions write, into one local LMDB store with BM25 and HNSW retrieval, so a conversation from any of the three is searchable from all of them.
